falsifiers: Low-usage rows account for less than 75 percent of hard errors, or their error rate does not exceed higher-usage rows.
All original final metrics must reproduce exactly; otherwise stop without attribution.
Any checkpoint/RNG/gradient buffer mutation, source/input hash mismatch, missing state or CPU budget excess invalidates analysis.
hypothesis: Hard routing leaves more uniform-prior rows weakly constrained by reconstruction; those rows account for larger independent-generation errors.
predictions: At least 75 percent of hard final decoder-mean errors arise from rows with expected posterior mass below 1 percent, and their error rate exceeds higher-usage rows.
Hard reconstruction/ELBO prior gradient reaches fewer rows than adversarial/SBNP terms on the fixed 64-input panel.
Report categorical control with identical analysis; concentration alone is not sufficient if it also occurs in the passing control.
scope: Saved final checkpoints only; no causal claim about unsaved terminal states. No retraining, continuation, retiering, gate change, new trainer or new toy.
stopping_rules: Analyze exactly the two archived final states, one 4096-input/eight-draw panel and one 64-input gradient panel per state.
No optimizer updates, training continuation, seed-only study, task gate edit, default promotion or extrapolation to unsaved states.
Preserve original hard FAIL/categorical PASS and reuse original actual-training GIFs.
